verses.original: גַּם־ אֵ֭לֶּה מִשְׁלֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶ֝עְתִּ֗יקוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י׀ חִזְקִיָּ֬ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’êl·leh miš·lê šə·lō·mōh ’ă·šer he‘·tî·qū ’an·šê ḥiz·qî·yāh me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: These are additional proverbs of Solomon which were copied by the men of Hezekiah king of Judah
verses.literalPt: Estes também são provérbios de Salomão, os quais transcreveram os homens de Ezequias, rei de Judá.

verses.original: כְּבֹ֣ד אֱ֭לֹהִים הַסְתֵּ֣ר דָּבָ֑ר וּכְבֹ֥ד מְ֝לָכִ֗ים חֲקֹ֣ר דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḇōḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm has·têr dā·ḇār ū·ḵə·ḇōḏ mə·lā·ḵîm ḥă·qōr dā·ḇār
verses.literal: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter and the glory of kings to search it out . . .
verses.literalPt: É a glória de Deus encobrir as coisas, mas a glória dos reis, esquadrinhá-las.

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣יִם לָ֭רוּם וָאָ֣רֶץ לָעֹ֑מֶק וְלֵ֥ב מְ֝לָכִ֗ים אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma·yim lā·rūm wā·’ā·reṣ lā·‘ō·meq wə·lêḇ mə·lā·ḵîm ’ên ḥê·qer
verses.literal: As the heavens are high and the earth is deep so the hearts of kings cannot be searched
verses.literalPt: O céu na sua altura, a terra na sua profundidade e o coração dos reis são inescrutáveis.

verses.original: הָג֣וֹ סִיגִ֣ים מִכָּ֑סֶף וַיֵּצֵ֖א לַצֹּרֵ֣ף כֶּֽלִי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḡōw sî·ḡîm mik·kā·sep̄ way·yê·ṣê laṣ·ṣō·rêp̄ ke·lî
verses.literal: Remove the dross from the silver and a vessel for a silversmith will come forth
verses.literalPt: Tirai da prata a escória, e dela o ourives tirará um vaso.

verses.original: הָג֣וֹ רָ֭שָׁע לִפְנֵי־ מֶ֑לֶךְ וְיִכּ֖וֹן בַּצֶּ֣דֶק כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḡōw rā·šā‘ lip̄·nê- me·leḵ wə·yik·kō·wn baṣ·ṣe·ḏeq kis·’ōw
verses.literal: Remove the wicked from the king’s presence and his throne will be established in righteousness
verses.literalPt: Tirai de diante do rei o perverso, e o seu trono será estabelecido na justiça.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּתְהַדַּ֥ר לִפְנֵי־ מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבִמְק֥וֹם גְּ֝דֹלִ֗ים אַֽל־ תַּעֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·had·dar lip̄·nê- me·leḵ ū·ḇim·qō·wm gə·ḏō·lîm ’al- ta·‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: Do not exalt yourself in the presence of the king and do not stand in the place of great men
verses.literalPt: Não te engrandeças na presença do rei, nem te ponhas no lugar dos grandes,

verses.original: כִּ֤י ט֥וֹב אֲמָר־ לְךָ֗ עֲ‍ֽלֵ֫ה הֵ֥נָּה מֵֽ֭הַשְׁפִּ֣ילְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י נָדִ֑יב אֲשֶׁ֖ר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṭō·wḇ ’ă·mār- lə·ḵā ‘ălêh hên·nāh mê·haš·pî·lə·ḵā lip̄·nê nā·ḏîḇ ’ă·šer rā·’ū ‘ê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: for it is better to be told . . . Come up here than to be demoted in the presence of the prince Even what you have seen with your own eyes
verses.literalPt: porque melhor é que te digam: Sobe para cá do que seres humilhado perante o príncipe, a quem os teus olhos veem.

verses.original: אַל־ תֵּצֵ֥א לָרִ֗ב מַ֫הֵ֥ר פֶּ֣ן מַה־ תַּ֭עֲשֶׂה בְּאַחֲרִיתָ֑הּ בְּהַכְלִ֖ים אֹתְךָ֣ רֵעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tê·ṣê lā·riḇ ma·hêr pen mah- ta·‘ă·śeh bə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh bə·haḵ·lîm ’ō·ṯə·ḵā rê·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: do not bring hastily to court Otherwise what will you do in the end when your neighbor puts you to shame
verses.literalPt: Não saias depressa a contender, para que, no fim, não saibas que fazer, quando o teu próximo te houver envergonhado.

verses.original: רִֽ֭יבְךָ רִ֣יב אֶת־ רֵעֶ֑ךָ וְס֖וֹד אַחֵ֣ר אַל־ תְּגָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: rî·ḇə·ḵā rîḇ ’eṯ- rê·‘e·ḵā wə·sō·wḏ ’a·ḥêr ’al- tə·ḡāl
verses.literal: Argue your case with your neighbor without betraying another’s confidence
verses.literalPt: Discute a tua causa a sós com o teu próximo e não reveles o segredo de outro,

verses.original: פֶּֽן־ יְחַסֶּדְךָ֥ שֹׁמֵ֑עַ וְ֝דִבָּתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א תָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: pen- yə·ḥas·seḏ·ḵā šō·mê·a‘ wə·ḏib·bā·ṯə·ḵā lō ṯā·šūḇ
verses.literal: lest he who hears you bring shame upon you and your infamy never go away
verses.literalPt: Para que aquele que te ouvir não te vitupere, e não se te apegue a tua infâmia.

verses.original: תַּפּוּחֵ֣י זָ֭הָב בְּמַשְׂכִּיּ֥וֹת כָּ֑סֶף דָּ֝בָ֗ר דָּבֻ֥ר עַל־ אָפְנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: tap·pū·ḥê zā·hāḇ bə·maś·kî·yō·wṯ kā·sep̄ dā·ḇār dā·ḇur ‘al- ’ā·p̄ə·nāw
verses.literal: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver
verses.literalPt: A palavra proferida a seu tempo é como maçãs de ouro em cestos de prata.

verses.original: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב וַחֲלִי־ כָ֑תֶם מוֹכִ֥יחַ חָ֝כָ֗ם עַל־ אֹ֥זֶן שֹׁמָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: ne·zem zā·hāḇ wa·ḥă·lî- ḵā·ṯem mō·w·ḵî·aḥ ḥā·ḵām ‘al- ’ō·zen šō·mā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is a wise man’s rebuke to a listening ear
verses.literalPt: Como pendentes de ouro e joias de ouro puro, assim é o sábio repreensor para o ouvido obediente.

verses.original: כְּצִנַּת־ שֶׁ֨לֶג׀ בְּי֬וֹם קָצִ֗יר צִ֣יר נֶ֭אֱמָן לְשֹׁלְחָ֑יו וְנֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲדֹנָ֣יו יָשִֽׁיב׃פ
verses.transliteration: kə·ṣin·naṯ- še·leḡ bə·yō·wm qā·ṣîr ṣîr ne·’ĕ·mān lə·šō·lə·ḥāw wə·ne·p̄eš ’ă·ḏō·nāw yā·šîḇ
verses.literal: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a trustworthy messenger to those who send him he refreshes the soul of his masters
verses.literalPt: Como o frescor da neve no tempo da ceifa, assim é o mensageiro fiel para os que o enviam, porque ele refrigera a alma dos seus amos.

verses.original: נְשִׂיאִ֣ים וְ֭רוּחַ וְגֶ֣שֶׁם אָ֑יִן אִ֥ישׁ מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ל בְּמַתַּת־ שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: nə·śî·’îm wə·rū·aḥ wə·ḡe·šem ’ā·yin ’îš miṯ·hal·lêl bə·mat·taṯ- šā·qer
verses.literal: Like clouds and wind without rain is the man who boasts of gifts never given
verses.literalPt: Como nuvens e ventos sem chuva, assim é o que se gaba de dádivas que não fez.

verses.original: בְּאֹ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם יְפֻתֶּ֣ה קָצִ֑ין וְלָשׁ֥וֹן רַ֝כָּ֗ה תִּשְׁבָּר־ גָּֽרֶם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ō·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim yə·p̄ut·teh qā·ṣîn wə·lā·šō·wn rak·kāh tiš·bār- gā·rem
verses.literal: Through patience . . . a ruler can be persuaded and a gentle tongue can break a bone
verses.literalPt: Pela longanimidade se abranda o príncipe, e a língua suave quebranta ossos.

verses.original: דְּבַ֣שׁ מָ֭צָאתָ אֱכֹ֣ל דַּיֶּ֑ךָּ פֶּן־ תִּ֝שְׂבָּעֶ֗נּוּ וַהֲקֵֽאתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇaš mā·ṣā·ṯā ’ĕ·ḵōl day·ye·kā pen- tiś·bā·‘en·nū wa·hă·qê·ṯōw
verses.literal: If you find honey eat just what you need lest you have too much and vomit it up
verses.literalPt: Achaste mel? Come só o que te basta, para que não te fartes dele e não o vomites.

verses.original: הֹקַ֣ר רַ֭גְלְךָ מִבֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֑ךָ פֶּן־ יִ֝שְׂבָּעֲךָ֗ וּשְׂנֵאֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·qar raḡ·lə·ḵā mib·bêṯ rê·‘e·ḵā pen- yiś·bā·‘ă·ḵā ū·śə·nê·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: Seldom set foot in your neighbor’s house lest he grow weary and hate you
verses.literalPt: Entra raras vezes na casa do teu próximo, para que se não enfade de ti e te aborreça.

verses.original: מֵפִ֣יץ וְ֭חֶרֶב וְחֵ֣ץ שָׁנ֑וּן אִ֥ישׁ עֹנֶ֥ה בְ֝רֵעֵ֗הוּ עֵ֣ד שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: mê·p̄îṣ wə·ḥe·reḇ wə·ḥêṣ šā·nūn ’îš ‘ō·neh ḇə·rê·‘ê·hū ‘êḏ šā·qer
verses.literal: Like a club or sword or sharp arrow is a man who bears false witness against his neighbor
verses.literalPt: O homem que diz falso testemunho contra o seu próximo é um malho, uma espada e uma flecha aguda.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣ן רֹ֭עָה וְרֶ֣גֶל מוּעָ֑דֶת מִבְטָ֥ח בּ֝וֹגֵ֗ד בְּי֣וֹם צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šên rō·‘āh wə·re·ḡel mū·‘ā·ḏeṯ miḇ·ṭāḥ bō·w·ḡêḏ bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: Like a broken tooth or a foot out of joint is confidence in a faithless man in time of trouble
verses.literalPt: Confiança num homem desleal no tempo da angústia é como dente quebrado e pé desconjuntado.

verses.original: מַ֥עֲדֶה בֶּ֨גֶד׀ בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָה חֹ֣מֶץ עַל־ נָ֑תֶר וְשָׁ֥ר בַּ֝שִּׁרִ֗ים עַ֣ל לֶב־ רָֽע׃פ
verses.transliteration: ma·‘ă·ḏeh be·ḡeḏ bə·yō·wm qā·rāh ḥō·meṣ ‘al- nā·ṯer wə·šār baš·ši·rîm ‘al leḇ- rā‘
verses.literal: Like one who removes a garment on a cold day or vinegar poured on a wound is one who sings songs to a heavy heart
verses.literalPt: Como aquele que despe o vestido num dia de frio e como vinagre sobre salitre, assim é aquele que canta canções ao coração triste.

verses.original: אִם־ רָעֵ֣ב שֹׂ֭נַאֲךָ הַאֲכִלֵ֣הוּ לָ֑חֶם וְאִם־ צָ֝מֵ֗א הַשְׁקֵ֥הוּ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- rā·‘êḇ śō·na·ʾă·k̲ā ha·’ă·ḵi·lê·hū lā·ḥem wə·’im- ṣā·mê haš·qê·hū mā·yim
verses.literal: If your enemy is hungry give him food to eat and if he is thirsty give him water to drink
verses.literalPt: Se o teu inimigo tiver fome, dá-lhe de comer; e, se tiver sede, dá-lhe de beber.

verses.original: כִּ֤י גֶֽחָלִ֗ים אַ֭תָּה חֹתֶ֣ה עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה יְשַׁלֶּם־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḡe·ḥā·lîm ’at·tāh ḥō·ṯeh ‘al- rō·šōw Yah·weh yə·šal·lem- lāḵ
verses.literal: For in so doing you will heap burning coals on his head and the LORD will reward you
verses.literalPt: Porque lhe amontoarás brasas vivas sobre a cabeça, e Jeová te recompensará.

verses.original: ר֣וּחַ צָ֭פוֹן תְּח֣וֹלֵֽל גָּ֑שֶׁם וּפָנִ֥ים נִ֝זְעָמִ֗ים לְשׁ֣וֹן סָֽתֶר׃
verses.transliteration: rū·aḥ ṣā·p̄ō·wn tə·ḥō·w·lêl gā·šem ū·p̄ā·nîm niz·‘ā·mîm lə·šō·wn sā·ṯer
verses.literal: As the north wind brings forth rain so a backbiting tongue brings angry looks
verses.literalPt: O vento do norte traz chuva, e a língua caluniadora, o rosto irado.

verses.original: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־ פִּנַּת־ גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מְדוֹנִים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ še·ḇeṯ ‘al- pin·naṯ- gāḡ mê·’ê·šeṯ mə·ḏō·nīm ū·ḇêṯ ḥā·ḇer
verses.literal: Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife
verses.literalPt: Melhor é morar no canto do eirado do que com uma mulher de contendas numa casa espaçosa.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם קָ֭רִים עַל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עֲיֵפָ֑ה וּשְׁמוּעָ֥ה ט֝וֹבָ֗ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: ma·yim qā·rîm ‘al- ne·p̄eš ‘ă·yê·p̄āh ū·šə·mū·‘āh ṭō·w·ḇāh mê·’e·reṣ mer·ḥāq
verses.literal: Like cold water to a weary soul is good news from a distant land
verses.literalPt: Como água fria a quem tem sede, tais são as boas notícias vindas dum país remoto.

verses.original: מַעְיָ֣ן נִ֭רְפָּשׂ וּמָק֣וֹר מָשְׁחָ֑ת צַ֝דִּ֗יק מָ֣ט לִפְנֵֽי־ רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ma‘·yān nir·pāś ū·mā·qō·wr mā·šə·ḥāṯ ṣad·dîq māṭ lip̄·nê- rā·šā‘
verses.literal: Like a muddied spring or a polluted well is a righteous man who gives way to the wicked
verses.literalPt: Como a fonte turvada e o manancial corrompido, assim é o justo que se abate perante o perverso.

verses.original: אָ֘כֹ֤ל דְּבַ֣שׁ הַרְבּ֣וֹת לֹא־ ט֑וֹב וְחֵ֖קֶר כְּבֹדָ֣ם כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḵōl də·ḇaš har·bō·wṯ lō- ṭō·wḇ wə·ḥê·qer kə·ḇō·ḏām kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: It is not good to eat too much honey or to search out one’s own glory . . .
verses.literalPt: Comer muito mel não é bom. Assim, esquadrinhar a própria glória não é glória.

verses.original: עִ֣יר פְּ֭רוּצָה אֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֑ה אִ֝֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵ֖ין מַעְצָ֣ר לְרוּחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘îr pə·rū·ṣāh ’ên ḥō·w·māh ’îš ’ă·šer ’ên ma‘·ṣār lə·rū·ḥōw
verses.literal: Like a city whose walls are broken down is a man who . . . does not control his temper
verses.literalPt: Aquele que não pode conter o seu espírito é como uma cidade derrubada, que não tem muros.
